nguyen-tri-phuong.name: Nguyễn Tri Phương
nguyen-tri-phuong.look: a dignified Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty general aged about 58, lean weathered face, long thin grey beard and grey mustache, calm stern eyes, black wrapped turban (khan van), dark indigo blue silk military robe with subtle embroidered cloud patterns, wide red sash, a sheathed long sword at his side

nguyen-trung-truc.name: Nguyễn Trung Trực

truong-dinh.name: Trương Định
truong-dinh.look: a sturdy Vietnamese militia leader aged about 42, square resolute face, short black beard and mustache, black wrapped turban, dark indigo knee-length tunic over white trousers, wide red sash, a long sword in his hand, plain red war banner without any writing behind him

linh-phap.name: Lính Pháp 1858 (hình tượng)
linh-phap.look: a French marine infantry soldier of 1858, European man with a mustache, dark navy blue wool tunic with brass buttons, white canvas sun-cover over a dark kepi with a neck flap, white cross belts, muzzle-loading rifle with fixed bayonet, leather cartridge box

quan-trieu-nguyen.name: Lính triều Nguyễn (hình tượng)
quan-trieu-nguyen.look: a Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty soldier of the 1850s, slim young man, small pointed lacquered conical hat (non dau) with a brass tip, short red tunic with dark blue borders and a plain round white patch on the chest without any characters, black trousers, bare feet, holding a long spear
